newsitem.title: USA: Kansas fed cattle trade very slow at $65 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas fed cattle trade very slow at $65 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow, with not enough slaughter steer or heifer sales confirmed for an adequate market test, USDA said. Inquiry was moderate and demand light.
Wk to date - 127,200 last week - 64,500 last year - 33,500
Slaughter Steers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1225 lbs 65.00; pen 1250 lb Holsteins 58.00. Slaughter Heifers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1075 lbs 65.00.

Feedlots were current following second largest one day volume on record of over 83,000 head, previous record 88,400 head Sept 6, 1995. Sales confirmed on 300 slaughter steers and 100 slaughter heifers Thursday. This week's confirmed sales 127,200 cattle including 39,000 head or about 31 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
